tasks.label: Docker CPU: evaluate
tasks.command: docker compose up -d --build && docker compose exec -T dev1 python -m scripts.run_test --verbose True

tasks.label: Docker GPU: check
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.gpu.yml run --rm train python -m scripts.check_gpu

tasks.label: Docker GPU: smoke train
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.gpu.yml run --rm train python -m scripts.train_smoke

tasks.label: Docker GPU: TensorBoard
tasks.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.gpu.yml run --rm -p 6006:6006 train tensorboard --logdir /workspace/artifacts --host 0.0.0.0 --port 6006
